title: Morning build
style: Natural window light, muted warm palette, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, photoreal. A single continuous shot, no scene cuts. No on-screen text, no logos, no captions.

shots.prompt: Slow dolly-in on an open laptop on an oak desk at dawn; the screen shows scrolling terminal output. Sound design: soft keyboard clicks and distant birdsong, no music, no dialogue.
Static close-up: a hand sets a ceramic mug of coffee beside the laptop, steam rising. Sound design: the clink of the mug on wood over quiet room tone, no music.
The camera tilts up from the desk to a tall window as sunlight spills across the room. Sound design: a low, warm ambient hum, no dialogue.
